description: Weighted Eikonal penalty lambda_eikonal * (||grad_x f||_2 - 1)^2 over caller-supplied precomputed input gradients; this is the Eikonal term from Gropp et al., §2 Eq. (2), with lambda=0.1 in §5. The caller computes grad_x f with create_graph=True as in the official IGR network.py:6-15; this entry omits the point-cloud fitting term. Clean-room implementation: src/topologies/implementations/losses/eikonal_sdf.py:8-35.

examples.title: Train a coordinate field with the Eikonal term

name: Eikonal signed-distance field gradient penalty

parameters.ignore_index: must be None because this term has no ignored labels
parameters.lambda_eikonal: finite nonnegative real weight for the Eikonal penalty (default 0.1)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point precomputed input gradients with shape [B, D], where B and D are positive
parameters.reduction: none returns one weighted penalty per point, mean averages points, or sum totals points (default mean)
parameters.targets: required by the generic loss signature and unused; targets do not affect the result

usage: Trainer(model, train, recipe='regression', recipe_config={'loss':'eikonal-sdf','loss_kwargs':{'lambda_eikonal':0.1}}); model returns differentiable precomputed input gradients
